vocab.definition: net movement of particles from high to low concentration.
diffusion of water across a partially permeable membrane.
moving substances against the gradient using energy.
the difference in concentration between two areas.

misconceptions.right: Diffusion is passive — it needs no energy.

misconceptions.wrong: Osmosis is the movement of any substance.
misconceptions.right: Osmosis is the movement of water only.
Particles still move, but there is no net change.

infoPanels.title: OSMOSIS ACROSS A MEMBRANE
infoPanels.secondaryContent: Water moves from a dilute solution to a concentrated one.
